description: This file contains PHP functions that provide access to a data model API. It includes functions for retrieving and setting multiple parameter values, managing object instances, and performing CRUD operations on configuration objects within a data model.

methods.name: DmGetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Retrieves multiple parameter values under a specified root object by delegating to an external extension API.

methods.name: DmSetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Sets multiple parameter values under a specified root object, delegating to an external extension API.

methods.name: DmGetInstanceIds
methods.description: Retrieves the list of instance IDs under a specified object table by delegating to an external extension API.

methods.name: DmAddObj
methods.description: Adds a new object instance under a specified object table.

methods.name: DmDelObj
methods.description: Removes an object instance specified by its full object name.
